nsfw.heading: Adult content (NSFW) display
nsfw.declare: I confirm that I am at least 18 years old and choose to view adult content.
nsfw.declareNote: We record the time of confirmation. Until then, the options below are locked to "Hide completely".

hide.title: Hide completely
hide.hint: NSFW content never appears, as if it did not exist. (Default)

blur.title: Blur
blur.hint: Shown as blurred thumbnails; click to reveal.

show.title: Show
show.hint: Displayed the same way as regular content.

nsfw.applyNote: This setting applies immediately across the site, including share pages and the future community feed.
nsfw.unconfirmed: Age confirmation withdrawn; display set to hide completely
nsfw.prefUpdated: Display preference updated across the site

language.heading: Language
language.hint: Applies immediately. While logged in, your choice is remembered and used on any device you sign in from.

account.heading: Account
account.idNote: Cannot be changed until the rename policy is finalised.

data.heading: Data & storage
data.note: Exporting all data and deleting your account will be available in a later release. To delete your account for now, email us via the contact link in the footer.

embed.heading: Embeds & API
embed.stateOn: Open: other sites can reference your public fursonas
embed.master: Allow embed cards, palette cards and the public API to read my public fursonas
embed.masterNote: Off by default. When on, only fursonas that are public, SFW and have a share link are exposed; private and NSFW content never is. Turning it off disables all embeds and API access immediately. Your data is served with noai headers and the Terms prohibit AI training use.
embed.noFursonas: No fursonas yet. Create one and generate a share link to get embed code here.
embed.apiNote: Anonymous, read-only, public SFW data only; 60 requests per minute, responses cacheable for 5 minutes. Image URLs are /api/img paths and can be used directly in .
